purpose: Explain hosted Lean connection failures and provide an in-page retry that reloads the current workbench source, with the pinned local check visible as a separate fallback.

files.relation_to_mathcase_source: Pages copy retains its site navigation and local receipt workflow while applying the same hosted-editor recovery controls

limits: The hosted compiler runs at live.lean-lang.org; MathCase cannot restart or repair its remote worker.
Reconnect reloads the current workbench source into a new embedded editor. Copy edits made only inside the old hosted editor back into the workbench before retrying.
The hosted editor follows its own Lean/Mathlib release. It is a convenience check and does not create a MathCase receipt; the pinned local checker remains separate.
This overlay does not promote an evidence gate or assert a mathematical result.
